opportunities.name: United flight search
opportunities.description: Search United for flights by entering a departure city/airport, a destination, dates, passenger count and cabin class, then run Find flights.
steps: Type departure city/airport and select the suggestion
Type destination and select the suggestion
Open the Depart/Date picker and choose departure and return dates (navigate months if needed)
Optionally select a fare or open Details/Seats
